data.one_liner: GTK utilities for Flutter Linux applications, providing settings and application lifecycle helpers.
data.what_it_does: The package offers a GtkSettings wrapper to access GSettings and a GtkApplication widget/notifier to listen to remote command‑line arguments and file‑open requests. It also includes a GtkIcon wrapper for GTK icons.
use_when: You are building a Flutter app for Linux and need to integrate with native GTK settings or handle remote command‑line/file‑open events.
You want a mockable GSettings API for testing on Linux.
avoid_when: Your app targets non‑Linux platforms (Android, iOS, web, Windows, macOS).
You need visual GTK widgets rather than non‑visual utilities.
strengths: Direct integration with native GTK APIs.
Simple Dart API for settings and application events.
weaknesses: Linux‑only; no support for other platforms.
Requires manual changes to linux/my_application.cc, increasing setup complexity.
Limited to non‑visual utilities; no UI components.
data.setup_notes: Edit linux/my_application.cc as described: modify activate, local_command_line, and my_application_new functions to use G_APPLICATION_HANDLES_COMMAND_LINE | G_APPLICATION_HANDLES_OPEN and present existing windows.
